newsitem.title: CHINA: Jilin Chemical Group to list 800 mln yuan bonds.
newsitem.headline: Jilin Chemical Group to list 800 mln yuan bonds.

text.p: Jilin Chemical Group, the biggest shareholder in Jilin Chemical Co, will list 800 million yuan worth of bonds on Tuesday on the Shanghai Stock Exchange, a company statement said on Monday.
The three-year bonds, with an annual coupon of 15 percent, were issued at face value on January 15, 1995, the statement said.

Jilin Chemical Group has invested all proceeds from the issue into a 300,000-tonne ethylene project, which is co-invested by Jilin Chemical and will be completed in 1997, it said. It gave no more details.
